question: Volcanica is called the God-Dragon; do King-Dragons and Ancient-Dragons also exist? Also, are dragons the highest form of life, as you’d expect?
answer: Even outside of Lugunica, dragons are well-known as creatures that you shouldn’t mess with. Having said that, none are called King-Dragon or Ancient-Dragon. I think even Volcanica himself has never introduced himself as the God-Dragon. They’re huge, strong lizards, you know; they just happen to be able to talk a bit.
